title: 17668 - 17668/P1260/004704
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to PD Unit Injector: Cylinder 1 (N240) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to PD Unit Injector: Cylinder 1 (N240)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  PD Unit Injector: Cylinder 1 (N240)
Kontrol edin:  Camshaft for Signs of wear
technicalNotes: Injectors on TDI PD/PPD Engines are not designed to run Waste Vegetable Oil (WVO) or Straight Vegetable Oil (SVO) as well as anything above 5% Biodiesel Content. Running these Types of Fuels can Damage the Injectors. Please Refer to the Owners Manual and/or Factory Repair Manual for a list of appropriate Fuel Types.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
